comment: CURRENT ACA Southern Tier corridor (2021+ editions), westbound Pensacola → San Diego, plus SD→LA continuation. Rebuilt 2026-08-18 from six parallel research passes over public sources: ACA public route/section/alert pages, the official ACA RideWithGPS collection (public map views), 2007–2026 public ride journals (crazyguyonabike, cycleblaze, blogs), state DOT documents, and OSM USBR 90 relations where — and only where — they are verified concurrent with the ST. Reconstructed legs are bicycle-routed between attested towns (lnglat = research-verified coordinates, used directly; no geocoding) and are labeled 'reconstructed' — never presented as official ACA geometry. Includes ACA's official Pearl River bridge detour (US 90 W Pearl bridge closed since 2022). Full evidence trail: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md + session research reports.

san_diego_terminus.name: San Diego – Dog Beach / Ocean Beach Park (ST western terminus, wheel-dip spot)

santa_monica_end.name: Santa Monica Pier (LA arrival placeholder — set to actual gig venue later)

osmSegments.name: Florida: Pensacola → Alabama line (coastal, ST = USBR 90 in all eras)
osmSegments.source: OSM relation 4264377 (USBR 90 Florida), FDOT open data. ST concurrence: ACA route page + 2007/2026 journals (Perdido Key coastal line).

osmSegments.name: Alabama: Gulf Shores + Mobile Bay Ferry (ST mainline; ferry is official)

anchorEast.name: FL/AL line near Orange Beach/Perdido Key

osmSegments.source: OSM relation 3317163 (USBR 90 Alabama, proposed; contributed by ACA USBRS coordinator). ST mainline confirmed: ACA names Gulf State Park Backcountry Trail, Mobile Bay Ferry, Dauphin Island. Mobile Bay Alternate (92.3 mi via Mobile) exists for ferry outages.
osmSegments.notes: Includes the Mobile Bay Ferry crossing (Fort Morgan → Dauphin Island, mobilebayferry.com); expect one ~4-mi water gap in geometry.

osmSegments.name: Louisiana: New Roads → Merryville (ST = USBR 90 west of the Mississippi)
osmSegments.source: OSM relation 3317164 (USBR 90 Louisiana, proposed; ACA USBRS coordinator). Current ST town-level concurrence verified (ACA route page names Mamou, Ville Platte, Bunkie, Simmesport, Morganza, DeRidder traffic note); street-level identity assumed via USBR 90.
osmSegments.notes: Chicot State Park (camping) is on-route between Bunkie and Ville Platte. Simmesport's Atchafalaya bridge has minimal shoulder.

osmSegments.name: Arizona: Morristown → Ehrenberg (US 60/I-10, ST–USBR 90 concurrence)
osmSegments.source: OSM relation 5509062 (USBR 90 Arizona, AASHTO-designated). Only ST-concurrent stretch of USBR 90 in AZ (Wickenburg–Aguila–Salome–Hope–Quartzsite–Ehrenberg); east of Morristown the two routes diverge entirely.
osmSegments.notes: Ehrenberg → Blythe uses the I-10 Colorado River bridge NORTH sidewalk (bikes prohibited on the bridge shoulders).

reconLegs.name: Mississippi Gulf Coast → New Orleans (current ST + official Pearl River detour)
reconLegs.source: Current ST (2021 ed.): coastal MS named by ACA + winter-2026 journal (Pascagoula, Biloxi, Bay St. Louis). Pearl crossing: US 90 W Pearl bridge CLOSED since 5/2022 — this leg follows ACA's OFFICIAL detour (route alert 9/2022; ACA RWGPS 40941288): Pass Christian→Kiln→Picayune→Bogalusa→Talisheek→Slidell.
reconLegs.notes: The US 90 Pearl River bridge has no reopening estimate (replacement unfunded as of Aug 2025), so this detour should be treated as the route for the foreseeable future. If it ever reopens, the mainline resumes Bay St. Louis→Waveland→Pearlington→Slidell and shortens the trip ~75 mi.

reconLegs.name: Louisiana: New Orleans → Baton Rouge → Audubon Bridge (current ST, 2021 reroute)
reconLegs.source: 2021 ACA reroute: Section 5 runs New Orleans→Baton Rouge via Mississippi River Trail levee paths (ACA S5: 'bike paths along the Mississippi River into New Orleans'; Norco/Bonnet Carré named on ACA route page), then US 61 north to the John James Audubon Bridge (sole crossing; ferry era ended 2011).
reconLegs.notes: Gramercy/St. Gabriel are river-hugging shaping points (corridor certain, exact street routing approximated). St. Francisville is a classic near-route overnight ~2 mi off US 61.

reconLegs.name: Texas: Sabine River → El Paso (current ST, 2023-edition corridor)
reconLegs.source: Town chain attested by 2021–2023 journals on current maps (CGOAB 24914 day pages, 24079; cycleblaze 2021) + ACA S3/S4/S5 public text. Austin via Lance Armstrong Bikeway; Fitzhugh–Pedernales Falls–Johnson City–Fredericksburg line current since ~2015/16 (replaces Wimberley/Blanco). La Grange is OFF-route (services spur). West TX: US 90 spine incl. Dryden + Valentine; El Paso valley on TX 20 (Fort Hancock–Tornillo–Fabens–Clint–Socorro mission trail).
reconLegs.notes: Van Horn→Sierra Blanca is I-10 shoulder (no parallel road). Marathon→Sanderson 55 mi and Sanderson→Comstock 89 mi have no services. US 281 into Johnson City: freeway-like, no shoulder (rider-reported 2023).

reconLegs.name: New Mexico: El Paso → Emory Pass → Silver City → Lordsburg (current ST)
reconLegs.source: Northern line verified as the official ST continuously since ≥2005 (ACA S2 public text: Silver City, Emory Pass 8,228 ft — highest point of the ST; journals 2005–2023; NMDOT NM 28 legal description). NM 28 west-bank line El Paso→Las Cruces via Mesilla. The Deming–Hachita 'bootheel' is an unofficial rider shortcut, never the ACA route.
reconLegs.notes: Kingston→San Lorenzo pins NM 152 over Emory Pass (8,228 ft). Official alternates near here: Anthony Gap (45.5 mi, skips downtown El Paso) and Gila Cliff Dwellings (91.3 mi scenic, from Silver City).

reconLegs.name: Arizona: Duncan → Safford → Globe → Tempe → Morristown (current ST, Gila line)
reconLegs.source: ACA S2 public text (US 70, Duncan, Safford, Globe, Tonto Basin, Roosevelt, Usery Pass, Tempe) + 2013–2023 journals. NOT USBR 90 east of Morristown (ACA staff 2017: the two routes 'separate from Phoenix to the New Mexico border' — USBR 90 runs Tucson/Bisbee/Douglas instead).
reconLegs.notes: Lordsburg→Duncan is US 70 (junction-routed). Tempe is the S1/S2 section junction. Phoenix metro via Arizona Canal corridor (street-level approximated), then Grand Ave/US 60 through Peoria/Surprise to Morristown.

reconLegs.name: California: Blythe → Imperial Valley → mountains → San Diego (current ST)
reconLegs.source: ACA S1 public text + journals: SR 78 via Ripley/Palo Verde/Glamis; mainline dips to Calexico via Heber (El Centro is near-route services, not on-line); SR 98 → Ocotillo → I-8 In-Ko-Pah grade → Old Hwy 80 (Jacumba, Boulevard, Tecate Divide 3,890 ft) → Pine Valley → Alpine → El Cajon → San Diego River path → Dog Beach.
reconLegs.notes: ACA advisory: an official 'Major Detour' now recommends avoiding SR 78 Brawley↔Blythe via the I-8/Yuma corridor (~16 mi shorter, rejoins at Peoria AZ) — kept as a note; the mapped mainline through Glamis is used here. Ocotillo→Jacumba climbs the I-8 shoulder (legal; no parallel road).

reconLegs.name: Continuation: San Diego → Los Angeles (Pacific Coast)
reconLegs.source: Pacific Coast Bike Route corridor (Caltrans-signed), well-documented coastal towns; NOT part of the Southern Tier.
